/*******************************************************************************
* Instrument: RTP_DIF
*
* Powder diffractometer with double/triple HOPG monochromator, sample
* environment (container + powder sample) and banana + single detector.
*
* Rebuilt from specification.
*******************************************************************************/

DEFINE INSTRUMENT RTP_DIF(lambda=2.36, DM=3.355, Mono_tilt=0,
                           string powder="Na2Ca3Al2F14.laz",
                           det_rotation=45)

DECLARE
%{
int mono_index;
%}

INITIALIZE
%{
printf("RTP_DIF: Monochromator take-off angle=%g [deg]\n",
    2*asin(lambda/2/DM)*RAD2DEG);
%}

TRACE

COMPONENT Origin = Progress_bar()
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT source = Source_gen(
    radius = .154/2,
    dist = 1.16+1.50,
    focus_xw = .11,
    focus_yh = .03,
    lambda0 = lambda,
    dlambda = .2,
    I1 = 2.79e12/4/PI,
    T1 = 300)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE Origin
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT CoarseCollimator1 = Guide(
    w1 = .154, h1 = .154, l = 1.16125, m = 0)
AT (0, 0, .01) RELATIVE source
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT CoarseCollimator2 = Guide(
    w1 = .11, h1 = .11, l = 1.5, m = 0)
AT (0, 0, 1.16125+0.003) RELATIVE CoarseCollimator1
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT lmon = Monitor_nD(
    xwidth = .11, bins = 50,
    options = "slit disk, auto wavelength",
    restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0, 0, 1.5+0.01) RELATIVE CoarseCollimator2
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Be_Position = Arm()
AT (0, 0, .147+.15/2) RELATIVE lmon
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT mono_cradle = Arm()
SPLIT 10
AT (0, 0, .145+.15/2+.176) RELATIVE Be_Position
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT mono_rotation = Arm()
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE mono_cradle
ROTATED (0, -asin(lambda/2/DM)*RAD2DEG, 0) RELATIVE mono_cradle
EXTEND
%{
mono_index=0;
%}

COMPONENT mono1 = Monochromator_curved(
    reflect = "HOPG.rfl", transmit = "HOPG.trm",
    NH = 1, NV = 1, mosaich = 48, mosaicv = 48,
    RV = 0, RH = 0, DM = DM, width = .11, height = .03)
AT (-.01, 0, 0) RELATIVE mono_rotation
ROTATED (0, Mono_tilt, 0) RELATIVE mono_rotation
EXTEND
%{
if (SCATTERED) mono_index=1;
%}

COMPONENT mono2 = Monochromator_curved(
    reflect = "HOPG.rfl", transmit = "HOPG.trm",
    NH = 1, NV = 1, mosaich = 48, mosaicv = 48,
    RV = 0, RH = 0, DM = DM, width = .11, height = .03)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE mono_rotation
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE mono_rotation
EXTEND
%{
if (SCATTERED) mono_index=2;
%}

COMPONENT mono3 = Monochromator_curved(
    reflect = "HOPG.rfl", transmit = "HOPG.trm",
    NH = 1, NV = 1, mosaich = 48, mosaicv = 48,
    RV = 0, RH = 0, DM = DM, width = .11, height = .03)
AT (.01, 0, 0) RELATIVE mono_rotation
ROTATED (0, -Mono_tilt, 0) RELATIVE mono_rotation
EXTEND
%{
if (SCATTERED) mono_index=3;
%}

COMPONENT mono_takeoff = Arm()
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE mono_cradle
ROTATED (0, -2*asin(lambda/2/DM)*RAD2DEG, 0) RELATIVE mono_cradle

COMPONENT psd_transmit = Monitor_nD(
    xwidth = .12, yheight = .12, bins = 50,
    options = "x y", restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0, 0, 0.25) RELATIVE mono_cradle
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
GROUP mono_rt

COMPONENT psd_reflect = Monitor_nD(
    xwidth = .12, yheight = .12, bins = 50,
    options = "x y", restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0, 0, 0.574) RELATIVE mono_takeoff
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
GROUP mono_rt

COMPONENT sample_psd = Monitor_nD(
    xwidth = .02, yheight = .02, bins = 50,
    options = "disk slit, x y", restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0, 0, 0.575+.50) RELATIVE mono_takeoff
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT sample_position = Arm()
SPLIT 100
AT (0, 0, .575+.5+.01) RELATIVE mono_takeoff
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT container_in = PowderN(
    reflections = "V.lau", radius = 0.01/2, yheight = 0.04,
    thickness = -50e-6, p_transmit = .95, d_phi = 50, concentric = 1)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE sample_position
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT sample = PowderN(
    reflections = powder, radius = 0.01/2, yheight = 0.04,
    d_phi = atan2(0.5,1)*RAD2DEG)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE sample_position
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
EXTEND
%{
if (!SCATTERED) ABSORB;
%}

COMPONENT container_out = PowderN(
    reflections = "V.lau", radius = 0.01/2, yheight = 0.04,
    thickness = -50e-6, p_transmit = .95, d_phi = 50, concentric = 1)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE sample_position
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT sample_out = Arm()
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE sample_position
ROTATED (0, det_rotation, 0) RELATIVE sample_position

COMPONENT det_big = Monitor_nD(
    yheight = .5, radius = 1,
    options = "banana theta limits=[-150 150] bins=300, y bins=64",
    restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE sample_position
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT det = Monitor_nD(
    xwidth = .5, yheight = .0254, bins = 25,
    options = "x", restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0, 0, 1) RELATIVE sample_out
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT reactor = Shape(
    radius = .7/2, yheight = .4)
AT (0, 0, -.35) RELATIVE Origin
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

FINALLY
%{
%}

END
